mapper.select: WITH compatible_beds AS ( SELECT bed.id AS bed_id, bed.room_id, bed.bed_code, bed.bed_type, bed.position_index, layout.layout_x, layout.layout_z, layout.rotation_degrees, bed.operational_status, room.room_number, room.capacity, room.resident_scope, floor.floor_number, building.id AS building_id, building.building_code, building.building_name, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM active_batch_room_lock room_lock WHERE room_lock.room_id=room.id ) AS room_locked, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_exchange_participant_lock exchange_lock JOIN room_assignment exchange_residency ON exchange_residency.student_id=exchange_lock.student_id AND exchange_residency.assignment_status='ACTIVE' AND exchange_residency.bed_id=bed.id ) THEN 'ROOM_EXCHANGE' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_assignment residency WHERE residency.bed_id=bed.id AND residency.assignment_status='ACTIVE' ) THEN 'RESIDENCY' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.bed_id=bed.id AND assignment.assignment_status='ACTIVE' ) THEN 'ALLOCATION' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed_confirmation_request confirmation WHERE confirmation.declared_bed_id=bed.id AND confirmation.request_status='PENDING' ) THEN 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS occupancy_source, COALESCE( ( SELECT residency.student_id FROM room_assignment residency WHERE residency.bed_id=bed.id AND residency.assignment_status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY residency.assigned_at DESC, residency.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT assignment.student_id FROM bed_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.bed_id=bed.id AND assignment.assignment_status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY assignment.assigned_at DESC, assignment.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT confirmation.student_id FROM bed_confirmation_request confirmation WHERE confirmation.declared_bed_id=bed.id AND confirmation.request_status='PENDING' ORDER BY confirmation.submitted_at, confirmation.id LIMIT 1 ) ) AS occupant_student_id FROM student JOIN bed JOIN room ON room.id=bed.room_id LEFT JOIN room_bed_layout layout ON layout.bed_id=bed.id JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.id=room.floor_id JOIN dormitory_building building ON building.id=floor.building_id WHERE student.id=#{studentId} AND building.enabled=1 AND room.operational_status='ENABLED' AND bed.operational_status='ENABLED' AND room.gender_restriction=student.gender AND ( (student.student_category='DOMESTIC' AND room.resident_scope IN ('DOMESTIC_ONLY','MIXED')) OR (student.student_category='INTERNATIONAL' AND room.resident_scope IN ('INTERNATIONAL_ONLY','MIXED')) ) AND (#{currentBedId} IS NULL OR bed.id<>#{currentBedId}) AND ( room.id=#{currentRoomId} OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_assignment resident WHERE resident.room_id=room.id AND resident.assignment_status='ACTIVE') < room.capacity ) ) SELECT compatible_beds.*, CASE WHEN compatible_beds.occupancy_source='AVAILABLE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS occupied, occupant.student_number AS occupant_student_number, occupant.student_name AS occupant_student_name, CONCAT(compatible_beds.building_name, ' ', compatible_beds.room_number, ' · ', compatible_beds.bed_code) AS display_name, CASE WHEN compatible_beds.room_locked=1 THEN '该寝室正被选寝批次锁定，暂不能调整' WHEN compatible_beds.occupancy_source='ROOM_EXCHANGE' THEN CONCAT('该床位由', COALESCE(occupant.student_name,'学生'), '使用，且正在办理寝室交换') WHEN compatible_beds.occupancy_source='RESIDENCY' THEN CONCAT('该床位已有在住学生：', COALESCE(occupant.student_name,'未知学生'), '，选择后可交换床位') WHEN compatible_beds.occupancy_source='ALLOCATION' THEN CONCAT('该床位已分配给：', COALESCE(occupant.student_name,'未知学生'), '，选择后可交换床位') WHEN compatible_beds.occupancy_source='PENDING_CONFIRMATION' THEN CONCAT('该床位正在等待', COALESCE(occupant.student_name,'学生'), '核查，暂不能调整') ELSE NULL END AS blocking_reason, CASE WHEN compatible_beds.room_locked=0 AND compatible_beds.occupancy_source IN ('AVAILABLE','RESIDENCY','ALLOCATION') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS selectable, CASE WHEN compatible_beds.occupancy_source IN ('RESIDENCY','ALLOCATION') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS swap_required FROM compatible_beds LEFT JOIN student occupant ON occupant.id=compatible_beds.occupant_student_id ORDER BY compatible_beds.building_code, compatible_beds.floor_number, compatible_beds.room_number, compatible_beds.bed_code
